name: Zoar
overview: Zoar was a small city of the Moabites located near the Jordan River, noted in Scripture as a place of refuge for Lot during the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah. It was part of the territory ruled by a king who joined in battle against Chedorlaomer alongside the kings of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim. Unlike the other cities of the plain, Zoar was spared from destruction, highlighting God's mercy in preserving a place of safety amidst judgment. The city's name, meaning 'Little,' reflects its modest size but significant role in God's providential protection.
